messages:
lee: Quick note — found an oddity in the Go SDK generator about context cancellation + streaming. Posting a short repro and suggestion.
lee: Repro (go-redwood v0.9.1):
```go
ctx, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
client := redwood.NewClient("$APIKEY")
gen := client.Generator("xgen-1")
stream, err := gen.Stream(ctx, redwood.StreamOptions{MaxTokens: 800})
if err != nil { log.Fatal(err) }

// reader loop
for {
  tok, err := stream.Next()
  if err != nil {
    log.Println("stream ended:", err)
    break
  }
  fmt.Print(tok.Text)
}

// from another goroutine cancel after 150ms
// observed: Next() never returns after cancel
```

anya: Hmm that's rough. Does the response body close on cancel? Iirc the Stream type didn't expose Close() in 0.9.1 so consumers couldn't forcefully close it.

ravi: Could be missing a select on ctx.Done() in the iterator's read loop. Also we should ensure the http.Request is created with ctx.

lee: Confirmed http.Request uses ctx but the iterator does a raw io.ReadFull on the resp.Body without a cancel-select. I saw the socket keep-alive staying open.

anya: Proposal: add (1) Stream.Close() that closes resp.Body and marks stream closed, (2) make Next() return context.Canceled if ctx done, (3) docs/example showing defer stream.Close(). That should match patterns in our Python SDK.

ravi: Sounds good. Suggest also adding Err() method on stream to surface terminal error and making Close idempotent.

devex-bot: labeled issue go:stream-cancel-leak

lee: I'll try a tiny patch branch; will test on Mac/Linux. Also will include a unit test that cancels ctx and asserts Next() unblocks.

anya: If you want, include a short example in quickstart for generator streaming with proper defer pattern.

ravi: Note for release notes: this is a patch-level behavior change but backwards compatible (only adds methods). We'll cut v0.9.2 once merged.

devex-bot: CI queued for branch go/stream-close

lee: local tests green. creating PR shortly.

devex-bot: PR opened: #419 — go-sdk: add Stream.Close() and respect ctx cancel

ravi: Reviewing PR.

anya: Thx Lee.

devex-bot: PR merged and v0.9.2 released (changelog link: https://changelogs.redwood.ai/go-redwood/0.9.2)

lee: Verified repro fixed. stream.Next() returns context.Canceled and loop terminates. Closing thread.
